name: Julia Sakuraba
source:
Despite having a talent for cooking, Julia opted to be a waitress in hopes of improving her relationships with her friends, including Anna. She’s very modest and polite, and she downplays any accomplishments she gets. Unwillingly finds herself in petty arguments with Mikaela.
